title: Gymnast from India Makes History
main_content:
For the first time in history, a woman gymnast from India will compete at the Olympics.

Dipa Karmakar won rights to compete in the 2016 Summer Olympic Games during a Test Event last weekend. The test event was held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

Karmakar is 22 years old. She is from the Indian state of Tripura. She qualified for the Olympics by finishing among the top 33 individual gymnasts at the Test Event.

Karmakar is also the first gymnast from India – male or female – to reach the Olympics in more than 50 years.

Supporters on social media praised and congratulated her.

Even Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke about Karmakar’s performance.

Also during the Test Event, the women’s gymnastics team from Romania failed to qualify to the Rio Olympics.

Romania placed seventh at the Test Event’s team competition. Only the top four teams at the event qualified to the Olympics.

Romania has won a medal in team gymnastics in every Olympics since 1976.

questions.question: What did Dipa Karmakar win?
options: A chance to train with the Indian gymnastics team
The rights to compete at the 2016 Summer Olympic Games
A gold medal in the Test Event
The title of National Gymnast of India
questions.answer: The rights to compete at the 2016 Summer Olympic Games
